trigger_clarity.instructions: Rate how clearly this SKILL.md explains when the skill should be invoked.

instruction_quality.instructions: Rate how actionable and sequenced the SKILL.md instructions are.

correctness.instructions: Rate internal consistency and testability from the supplied excerpt, without assuming external correctness.

safety.instructions: Rate how clearly the instructions bound risky actions and protect the user; do not certify security.

context_efficiency.instructions: Rate signal-to-noise and compactness of the supplied skill instructions.

evaluator.scope: Open JEV reviews at most the first 4,000 UTF-16 code units of SKILL.md; supporting files and runtime behavior are not assessed. Scores have no written reasons or recommendations.
